fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: A slow sting that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tide Comes Due
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a blow that deals 20 damage plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, using them all up with 70% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Float and Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second for 8 seconds. An escort of stingers fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Reprisal
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
